dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The most prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit irregular, serrated white perimeters. There is a sharp, high-contrast gradient transition from the dark charcoal background to the lighter interior regions of the rings.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high spatial density of small, solid white pixel clusters is concentrated along the dorsal ridge. These blobs show high core pixel intensity and lack an internal gradient, appearing as distinct punctate marks.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest anterior annuli form a scalene triangle, where the distance between the two leading annuli is roughly 50% of the distance to the third, more posterior annulus.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A bright orange/red artificial identification tag is visible on the posterior flipper.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct 'Y'-shaped intersection of high-contrast boundaries is visible in the mid-dorsal region between several primary ring structures.
